notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b003:l004: Karabair breed, primary Yudakhin карабайыр crossbred enduring horse, not ordinary black horse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b003:l006: Primary Yudakhin билек quotes exact калбыр өпкө жез билек: light, enduring racehorse. Sieve lungs and copper forelegs literal images retained, repeated18.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b003:l008: Wild-ram round neck, boar rump/owl feet10 literal horse comparisons, no invented species anatomy.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b003:l012: Теке жоомарт splendid racehorse, primary https://el-sozduk.kg/жоомарт/48, not generous goat.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b003:l014: Tuuchunak provisionally named horse; Manas encyclopedia https://el-sozduk.kg/agynay/ Agynai owns Tuuchunak, Sarytaz borrows. Printed lowercase can denote epithet; no invented ear anatomy. Short-necked retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b003:l019: Black-steel bits, six days without rest/water and racing prowess literal hyperbole preserved.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b003:l024: Көйкашка renowned, established primary dictionary, not shameless or assumed white blaze.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b003:l026: Each different horse, no new classes invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b003:l028: Тайкушум in Аргымак жалдуу тайкушум remains unidentified. Horse-mane comparison alone insufficient for full verse. No bird species or personal name invented. Completion-first first pass: Low-confidence approximate rendering for “Аргымак жалдуу тайкушум”; nearest corpus parallel was “Аргымак сатуу, биз тартуу,”.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b003:l035: Right ear specifically laid back, not both.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b003:l036: Earth crust flung overhead in pawing, black bit struck against throat literal source; no modern horse-care explanation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b004:l002: Primary Yudakhin чаткаяк exact silk-tail couplet: thighs from groin to knee, not tail beating genitalia.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b004:l005: Primary Yudakhin сай exact сай-сайлап жүнү бөлүнүп fur separated into furrows by sweat. Sweat supported, not arbitrary trim stripes.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b004:l006: Wild-sheep eyes, head tossing, forelock skyward and hooves earthward all distinct images retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b004:l012: Primary Yudakhin кайкы I2 exact Kanykei formula маңдай сөөгү кайкы экен / көрөр күнү тайкы эле means ill fate and hard life ahead, not literal curved forehead or few days left to live. Visually wrapped13 joined;15 hard life accordingly.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b004:l016: Conditional misfortune obstructing her, no affirmative claim horse must lose.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b004:l018: Horse head lowered to ground in racing, not death invented; first prize20.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b004:l024: Shame death conditional on horse losing, not actual narrated death.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b004:l030: Болбосо alternative retained as Or else following negative possibility; rhetorical oscillation not harmonized.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b004:l031: Rivers/springs through valleys retained literal; possible endearment attachment to child32 uncertain, no trip invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0216:b004:l036: Ten plains filled with tears literal hyperbole; moon/night conditional extends217.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0217:b003:l001: Reporting formula деп restored as she said during pair review, followed by reopened direct speech. Day/night parallel216 retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0217:b003:l009: Жетесиз канды төгөрмүн worthless/unworthy blood; кан interpreted blood with spill verb, not a khan murdered. Victim and self-reference not invented.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0217:b003:l013: Бел support/back metaphor; renowned champion supplied provisionally from белгилүүм, absence of Kyrgyz supporters explicit15.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0217:b003:l018: Огой read Nogai with dropped initial н, primary2010 editorial preface discusses spelling. No mysterious Ogoy person invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0217:b003:l021: Араан devouring maw, retain horse mouth hyperbole.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0217:b003:l025: Primary Yudakhin телик: small male falcon, also epic gripping bird of prey. Generic bird of prey avoids unsupported vulture species. Threat to corpse conditional, not actual death.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0217:b003:l036: Before appointed death explicit character lament, no newly narrated death.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0217:b005:l017: Primary Yudakhin орокто rider dipping/bobbing, commander of ten not ten heads. Корокто next line poles jut up, not croaking.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0217:b005:l019: Wrestlers hulking/flailing and warriors swaggering separate verbal images.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0217:b005:l029: Kanykei character threatens slaughter/eye-gouging; no actual event asserted and no procedural detail added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0217:b005:l031: Жолу болгон whose way has gone well, fortune epithet retained, not road ownership.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0217:b005:l034: Даңгыт dogs, not ethnicity. Threat retained without added gore.
